title: Pay by card
notes:
- Pay by card: plans can now be paid by card as well as with PayPal. Checkout and card management run on Stripe's own secure pages - AI Portal never sees your card
- Billing shows how your plan is paid, and a card plan has Manage card & invoices: change the card and get your invoices and receipts on Stripe's page
- The plan screen only offers the payment methods that are set up
- Receipts and refund confirmations say how you paid
